## REQ-CMP-008

**Resource interaction patterns via the Method element**

From Level 2 on, a component supports the resource interaction patterns of the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set and Del where applicable, and publishing resources via Pub (MG 7.4, MG 9.1). The methods per entity type are detailed by REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-016, REQ-CMP-033 and REQ-CMP-034.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 7.4, MG 9.1
- Refs: MG 1.3
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-690c85af

> Resource interaction patterns via the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set and Del (where applicable) and publishing resources via Pub (7.4 Method Element, 9.1 Resources) - Mandatory Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

## REQ-CMP-009

**Complete MQTT client behavior**

A component implements the complete MQTT client behavior of MG 6: client identifier, keep alive, clean session, quality of service, retained messages and the general behavior on changes.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 6.2.3, MG 6.2.4, MG 6.2.5, MG 6.3.1, MG 6.3.2, MG 6.4
- Refs: MG 1.3
- Verification: d7-test, d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-0745092e, MG-1.3-7f72acf8

> Complete MQTT client behavior (6.2.3 Client Identifier, 6.2.4 Keep Alive, 6.2.5 Clean Session, 6.3.1 Quality of Service Level, 6.3.2 Retained Messages, 6.4 General Behavior of MQTT on Changes) Recommended Recommended Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

Notes: Origin: GL-ADR-009 (compliance levels). This requirement is the grading rule of the listed sections; the effective level of each rule is given by the single requirements REQ-MQTT-013 … REQ-MQTT-019: at Levels 1 and 2 all of them are SHOULD; at Level 3 a "must" of the guideline becomes MUST and a "should" stays SHOULD (e.g. ClientId, keep alive, clean session, QoS 0). Other rows can make a behavior mandatory at all levels, e.g. publishing Health on change (MG 9.1.2, REQ-TOP-017, REQ-CMP-007). PO review of C-026 (SF-061 (b)): the close message (MG 6.3.4) moved to its own row of MG 1.3, see REQ-CMP-046; the remaining rows of this requirement are unchanged. PO decision (C-026): keep this grading, the note only explains it.

## REQ-CMP-010

**Complete Message Bus behavior**

At Level 3, a component supports all methods, resources and common services (REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-021, REQ-CMP-033 to REQ-CMP-040), each with all methods MG 9 defines for it and conforming completely to MG 9, also for resources for which it has no content (REQ-CMP-041 to REQ-CMP-043). At Level 2, this is recommended beyond the Level 2 requirements.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 9
- Refs: MG 1.3, SF-037
- Verification: d7-test, d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-0745092e, MG-1.3-0fc2e320, MG-1.3-88c2af43

> Complete Message Bus behavior: all methods, resources and common services, i.e. in addition the methods Set and Del for all resources for which they are defined, the methods Call and Reply, the resources Config, Data, Metadata, Event, Profile, PublicationList, SubscriptionList and ReferenceDesignation and the common service NewDataSetWriterId, also if the component has no content for a resource (9 Message Bus Communication, 9.1 Resources) - Recommended Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

Notes: SF-037 (decided by the PO in C-015, resolved in the guideline) – Level 3 requires all messages.

## REQ-CMP-013

**Registry may show an observed messaging compliance level**

The OEC Registry may show an observed OEC Messaging Compliance level per application and device, derived from the observed behavior (e.g. the resources listed in Profile and the answers to Get requests). The observed level is informative only and does not replace the declared and validated level.

- Keyword: MAY
- Domain: platform · Applies to: registry
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG A1
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-200baca0, MG-1.3-886a2a1d

## REQ-CMP-016

**Methods Set and Del for resources offered for modification**

From Level 2 on, an application or device supports the methods Set and Del for every resource it offers for modification by other participants on the Message Bus (e.g. Config) ("where applicable"). Level 1 entities are not required to support Set or Del. At Level 3, REQ-CMP-033 extends this to all resources.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity offers a resource for modification by other participants.
- Refs: MG 1.3, SF-037
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-690c85af, MG-1.3-78fd4a47

> From Level 2 on, the methods Set and Del must be supported for every resource that the component offers for modification by other participants on the Message Bus, such as Config ("where applicable").
> — MG 1.3

> They are not required for other resources at Level 2.
> — MG 1.3

## REQ-CMP-025

**Field presence follows the Requirement attribute**

In every payload object, a field whose attribute Requirement is Mandatory is present, and a field whose Requirement is Not used is absent. A field marked Optional may be present.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 1.2
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.2-5d607928

> The attribute Requirement of a field: Mandatory means the field must be present, Optional means the field may be present and Not used means the field must not be present.
> — MG 1.2

- Inventory: MG-9.1-379b5763

> — MG 9.1

Notes: Decided by the PO in C-016 (SF-039, option a + may).

## REQ-CMP-045

**Represented entities match the level of the representing application**

An application that represents entities without an own MQTT client on the Message Bus (e.g. field devices behind a connector or gateway) and provides information for them publishes and answers on their behalf; a represented entity does not communicate on the Message Bus itself. The application fulfills the requirements of its own compliance level for each represented entity: the resources and methods it offers for a represented entity (Source = the entity's identifier) match its own level. PublicationList, SubscriptionList and the common services are provided once by the representing application, not per represented entity.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application represents entities without an own MQTT client.
- Scope: MG 7.6
- Refs: MG 1.3
- Verification: d7-test, d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-1.3-b6aedd9a, MG-1.3-bf3a41de, MG-1.3-c42cc91d

> The representing application publishes and answers on behalf of the represented entity.
> — MG 1.3

> An application that provides information for individual represented entities must fulfill the requirements of its compliance level for each of these entities, i.e. the resources and methods it offers for a represented entity must match its own compliance level.
> — MG 1.3

> The representing application must provide the resources PublicationList and SubscriptionList and the common services once for itself; they are not required per represented entity.
> — MG 1.3

Notes: GL-ADR-017 (PO request, C-017) replaced the former MG 7.2.1/7.2.2 split into applications and devices. PO review (C-017) – confirmed; a represented entity never acts itself, the representing service always answers on its behalf.
